purpose: Regression floor for the Collective Intelligence Chain. This is NOT a target and NOT a claim of completion. The gate fails the build when measured readiness falls BELOW this floor, so the chain cannot silently rot the way it did after the 2026-09-26 reset. It never fails the build merely for being incomplete, because a permanently red gate gets ignored, which is the same failure mode as no gate at all.
why_not_higher: L01 requires an authoritative Intelligent Block identity and receipt from the governed nayanet-intelligence-commit-runtime boundary. A locally minted id can never satisfy it.

L04 is NOT_SATISFIED: the kernel graph seed declares epistemic_default 'UNVERIFIED', which is not in the canonical epistemicState enum. Which side is correct is a governed decision, so the gate surfaces the conflict instead of choosing.
L05-L11 are UNKNOWN: their evidence is runtime-produced and cannot be inspected on this branch. UNKNOWN is not evidence. Per the anti-false-positive law, missing evidence is never PASS.
how_to_raise_this_floor: Raise it only when a link moves to SATISFIED on independently inspectable evidence, and record which link and what evidence justified it. Never raise it to make a build green.
